title: What the core tells the Portal about one finished call
description: The one definition of the Call record shape. The core sends it to POST /api/calls/ (VOI-41) and the Portal stores it (portal/accounts/models.py CallRecord); tests/portal/test_call_records.py fails when the Portal drifts from it. Numbers, codes and times only: no field can hold words or audio. Every time is UTC. The cost is a decimal string in US dollars (Google's own currency), so no float rounds it.

cost_usd.description: Dollars at the time of the call, or null when it could not be worked out (then cost_reason says why).

price_date.description: The date of the price list the cost used, or null when none was read.

cost_reason.description: A short code (lower case and underscores, never a sentence) saying why cost_usd is empty; null when the cost is there.
